root.name: STマイクロエレクトロニクス

rows.ja: 顧客(STの年次報告に記載)

relations.text: 2026年2月9日に、STはAmazon Web Services(AWS)との戦略的協業を拡大し、複数年・数十億米ドル規模の商用契約を結んだと発表した
relations.text_en: On February 9, 2026, ST announced an expanded strategic collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) through a multi-year, multi-billion USD commercial engagement

source.label: STMicroelectronics 20-F
source.quote: On February 9, 2026, we announced an expanded strategic collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) through a multi-year, multi-billion USD commercial engagement serving several product categories, to enable new high performance compute infrastructure for cloud and AI data centers.

relations.text: STがQualcomm Technologiesと2024年に発表した協業の最初の製品が、STM32マイコン搭載システムの無線接続の実装を簡素化する
relations.text_en: The first product of ST's collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies, announced in 2024, simplifies implementing wireless connectivity in systems containing STM32 MCUs

source.label: STMicroelectronics 20-F
source.quote: It is the first product of ST’s collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. announced in 2024, to simplify implementing wireless connectivity in systems containing STM32 MCUs.

relations.text: 2025年7月24日、NXPはSTMicroelectronics International N.V.との間で、ある事業を最大9.5億ドル(クロージング時9億ドル、技術マイルストーン達成で最大5,000万ドル)の現金で売却する最終契約に合意した
relations.text_en: On July 24, 2025, NXP reached a definitive agreement with STMicroelectronics International N.V. to sell a business for up to $950 million in cash, including $900 million at closing and up to $50 million on technical milestones

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: On July 24, 2025, NXP reached a definitive agreement with STMicroelectronics International N.V., under which NXP will sell the business for an amount up to $ 950 million in cash, including $ 900 million at closing and up to an additional $ 50 million subject to the achievement of technical milestones.
source.note: NXPの年次報告にある、売却側からの記載です。
source.note_en: Described from NXP's side as the seller.

relations.text: NXPセミコンダクターズの年次報告が、STマイクロエレクトロニクスを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names STMicroelectronics as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: NXP Semiconductors 10-K
source.quote: Our primary key public competitors in alphabetical order include, but are not limited to, Analog Devices Inc., Broadcom Inc., Infineon Technologies AG, Microchip Technology Inc., Qualcomm Inc., Renesas Electronics Corp., STMicroelectronics NV and Texas Instruments Inc.

relations.text: CEVAは、STMicroelectronicsが一部の用途でCEVAの設計のライセンスを受けていると記している
relations.text_en: CEVA says STMicroelectronics licenses its designs for some applications

source.label: CEVA 10-K
source.quote: Companies such as NXP and STMicroelectronics license our designs for some applications and use their own proprietary cores for other applications.
source.note: ライセンス先の例示としての記載です。

relations.text: 最大顧客のAppleが2025年の売上高の17.7%を占めた

source.quote: In 2025 our largest customer, Apple, accounted for 17.7% of our total revenues.

relations.text: Appleの比率は2025年、2024年、2023年の純売上高のそれぞれ17.7%、14.5%、12.3%だった
relations.text_en: Apple accounted for 17.7%, 14.5% and 12.3% of ST's net revenues in 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively

source.label: STMicroelectronics 20-F
source.quote: In 2025, 2024 and 2023, our largest customer, Apple, accounted for 17.7%, 14.5% and 12.3% of our net revenues, respectively, reported within our four reportable segments.
